resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com lists a 72-foot observation tower at this site in 1924 and says it was abandoned in 1948. The 1924 memoir describes a 72-foot tower on Pinkham Ridge whose work was halted by snow, and it does not name the site. The two may describe one tower or two; the story reports both accounts and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Pinkham Patrol (48.74602, -115.04694) is about 12 km from the Pinkham Mountain record (48.64316, -115.09171), which has its own story. Pinkham Mountain's story cites a 70-foot tower from a September 1924 Inter Lake item, and this record has a 72-foot tower on the same year. Check before publishing that the two records are not one tower. Record elevation_m is still null; firelookout.com gives 5,463 ft (about 1,665 m). No source read explains the name Pinkham Patrol. No staffing, fire, access or photo information was found.
